prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing page direction comp for TomorrowWorks
Render a complete 1440×900 public Malaysian career guidance website viewport, edge to edge, with crisp readable text and the beginning of the next section. The visitor needs a calm, human invitation to consider a next career direction.
Content: brand “TomorrowWorks”; navigation “Explore careers”, “Job market”, “How it works”, “For organisations”; utility “BM / 中文”; headline “Your experience can take you further.”; supporting line “Start with the work you know. We’ll help you see what it can become.”; field “What do you do now?” containing “Accounting assistant”; action “Find my direction”; quiet note “No CV required”. The next section begins with “Built around real working lives.”
Direction: Human Horizon. Keep the opening almost entirely typographic on a light matte field. Use one narrow, documentary-style crop of a Malaysian professional’s hands and work materials along the lower edge as the transition into the next section, rather than a split hero or a stock portrait. The photograph feels observational, naturally lit and unposed. It must support the person’s dignity without acting as a marketing claim.
Use soft mineral white, dark charcoal-green text, one muted terracotta accent, fine editorial type and disciplined margins. Premium means calm, tactile and specific.
Do not add cards, career maps, data panels, statistics, badges, testimonials, dramatic gradients, smiling stock portraits, AI imagery or decorative illustrations. No browser frame or watermark.
